summary: Virginia Electric and Power Company filed an 8-K reporting an underwriting agreement for a $1.95 billion debt issuance, comprising $1.25 billion of 5.65% Senior Notes due 2036 and $700 million of 6.30% Senior Notes due 2056. The notes were sold via underwriters including BMO, CIBC, Mizuho, Morgan Stanley, and TD Securities, under an existing Form S-3 shelf. No special-situation elements exist; this is routine debt financing.
